1: Jab woh yaqeeni waqe hone wali Qayamat qayam hogi.
2: Koi jaan na hogi jo us ka inkar kare jaise woh duniya mein inkar karti thi.
3: Woh gunahgaar kafiron ko neecha kar degi unhein aag mein daakhil kar ke, aur woh parhezgaar mominon ko buland kar degi unhein Jannat mein daakhil kar ke.
5: Aur pahaad bilkul reza reza kar diye jaayenge.
6: Is reza reza hone ki wajah se woh bikhri hui gard ban jaayenge.
7: Us din tum teen qismon mein hoge.
8: Daayin Haath wale, jinhein un ki kitabein un ke daayin haath mein di jaayengi. Un ka darja kitna buland aur bada hoga!
9: Baayin Haath wale, jinhein un ki kitabein un ke baayin haath mein di jaayengi. Un ke darje kitne zaleel aur badnaseeb honge.
10: Aur woh log jo duniya mein nek aamaal mein aage barhne wale the, woh aakhirat mein bhi Jannat mein daakhil hone mein aage barhne wale honge.
11: Wahi log hain jo Allah ke qareeb kiye jaayenge.
12: Niyamat ke baagon mein, woh tarah tarah ki niyamat se faida uthayenge.
13: Ek giroh is Ummat se aur pehli Ummaton se.
14: Aakhir zamane mein thode log un aage barhne walon mein se honge jo qareeb kiye jaayenge.
15: Un takhton par jo sone se bune gaye hain.
16: In takhton par ek doosre ke saamne tike hue, aur koi doosre ki pith ki taraf na dekhega.
17: Aise bachche un ke aas-paas ghoomenge jo kabhi budhapa ya khatma na dekhenge, un ki khidmat ke liye.
18: Woh un ke aas-paas bagair dastey ke kooze, dastey wale kooze aur us be-had sharab ke pyale le kar ghoomenge jo Jannat mein behti hai.
19: Woh duniya ki sharab jaisi nahin; us ke peene walon ko na sar-dard hoga aur na nasha.
20: Yeh bachche un ke aas-paas phal bhi le kar ghoomenge, jin mein se woh chun sakenge.
21: Woh un parindon ka gosht bhi le kar ghoomenge jis ki un ke dil khwahish karenge.
22: Aur Jannat mein un ke liye khoobsoorat, badi aankhon wali auratein bhi hongi.
23: Un motiyon ki tarah jo apne khol mein mehfooz hain.
24: Un nek aamaal ke badle mein jo woh duniya mein karte the.
25: Woh Jannat mein koi bekar baat na sunenge, aur na koi aisi baat jis se gunah ho.
26: Woh sirf farishton ka unhein salaam karna, aur ek doosre ke salaam sunenge.
27: Aur Daayin Haath wale: Daayin Haath wale kaun hain? Allah ke nazdeek un ka darja aur martaba beshak bada hai!
28: Woh aisi beriyon mein honge jo be-zaraar aur be-kaante hain.
29: Aur kele, ek doosre ke saath qataar mein saliqe se lage hue.
30: Aur lambe, musalsal, na hilne wale saaye.
31: Aur behta paani jo kabhi rukta nahin.
32: Aur bohat se phal jinhein ginna mumkin nahin.
33: Woh kabhi khatm na honge, kyunke woh mausam ke paband nahin, aur na kisi waqt un ki khwahish aur un ke darmiyan koi cheez aayegi.
34: Aur uthe hue bichhaune, takhton par bichhaye gaye.
35: Beshak Hum ne un badi aankhon wali auraton ko, jin ka zikr hua, ek ajeeb tareeqe se paida kiya.
36: Hum ne unhein bakira banaya, pehle se kisi ne na chhua.
37: Woh apne shauhar se bohat muhabbat karne wali hain, aur un ke hum-umar.
38: Hum ne unhein Daayin Haath walon ke liye paida kiya: woh log jinhein un ki fazeelat ki nishani ke tor par daayin taraf le jaaya jayega.
39: Woh pehle Ambiya ki Ummaton mein se ek giroh hain.
40: Aur Muhammad ﷺ ki Ummat mein se ek giroh, jo tamam Ummaton ki aakhiri Ummat hai.
41: Albatta Baayin Haath wale: Baayin Haath wale kaun hain? Un ka haal aur anjam beshak bohat bura hai.
42: Woh shadeed garam hawaon aur nihayat garam paani mein honge.
43: Aur kaale dhuen ke saaye mein.
44: Na woh khushnuma hoga aur na dekhne mein achcha.
45: Beshak azaab ke paas aane se pehle woh duniya mein aish ki lazzaton se faida utha rahe the, sirf apni khwahishon ki parwah karte hue.
46: Woh Allah ke saath kufr aur us ke siwa buton ki ibadat par ar jaate the.
47: Woh dobara uthne ka inkar bhi karte the, aur woh us ke baare mein mazaaq uraate aur use door ki baat samajhte hue kehte the: 'Kya jab hum mar jaayenge aur mitti aur gali aur reza reza haddiyan ban jaayenge, hum us ke baad dobara uthaye jaayenge?'
48: 'Kya hamare woh purane baap-dada bhi uthaye jaayenge jo hum se pehle mar gaye?'
49: Aey Rasool! Dobara uthne ke in munkiron se keh dein: 'Beshak pehli naslein aur un mein se baad wale,
50: woh sab jald yaqeenan Qayamat ke din hisaab aur badle ke liye jama kiye jaayenge.'
51: Phir, aey tum log jo dobara uthne ko jhutlate ho aur seedhe raaste se bhatke hue ho!
52: Tum Qayamat ke din Zaqqoom ke darakht ke phalon mein se khaoge, jo sab se bure aur sab se ghinoone phal hain.
53: Tum apne bhooke pet us karwe darakht ke phalon se bharoge.
54: Phir tum us ke oopar nihayat garam paani piyoge.
55: Tum us ko itna piyoge jaise woh oont peeta hai jo jalti pyaas mein hai.
56: Woh karwa phal aur nihayat garam paani jis ka zikr hua tumhari woh mehmaan-nawazi hai jis se tumhara badle ke din istiqbaal kiya jayega.
57: Aey jhutlane walo! Hum ne tumhein nahin hone se paida kiya, pas tum kyun iman nahin laate ke Hum tumhein tumhari maut ke baad dobara uthayenge?
58: Aey logo! Kya tum us nutfe ko nahin dekhte jo tum apni biwiyon ke peton mein daalte ho?
59: Kya tum ho jo us nutfe ko paida karte ho, ya main hoon jo use paida karta hai?
60: Main tumhare darmiyan maut muqarrar karta hoon; tum mein se har ek ke liye ek muqarrar muddat hai jis se woh na aage barhta hai aur na us se peeche rehta hai. Aur main aajiz nahin
61: ke tumhari woh soorat aur shakal badal doon jo ab tumhari hai, aur tumhein ek aisi soorat aur shakal mein dobara banaoon jise tum nahin jaante.
62: Beshak tum jaante ho ke Hum ne tumhein pehli baar kaise paida kiya, pas kya tum nasihat nahin lete aur nahin samajhte ke woh hasti jis ne tumhein pehli baar paida kiya tumhein tumhari maut ke baad dobara uthane par qaadir hai?
63: Kya tum un beejon ko dekhte ho jo tum zameen mein bote ho?
64: Kya tum ho jo us beej ko ugate ho, ya main hoon jo use ugata hai?
65: Agar main chaahoon ke us kheti ko barbaad kar doon, to main aisa kar sakta hoon us ke pakne aur kaatne ke qareeb aane ke baad. Phir tum hairan reh jate us par jo use pahuncha.
66: Tum kehte: 'Beshak hum ne woh sab kho diya jo hum ne kharch kiya, aur hum saza paa gaye.'
67: 'Balke hum rizq se mehroom kar diye gaye.'
68: Kya tum us paani ko dekhte ho jo tum peete ho jab tum pyaase hote ho?
69: Kya tum ho jo use aasman ke baadalon se giraate ho, ya main hoon jo use utarta hai?
70: Agar main chahta ke us paani ko nihayat karwa bana doon, aisa ke woh na peene ke kaam aata aur na seenchne ke, to main aisa kar deta. Pas kya tum mera shukr na karoge ke main ne use peene ke laayaq aur tumhare liye ek rehmat bana kar utara?
71: Kya tum us aag ko dekhte ho jo tum apne faidon ke liye jalaate ho?
72: Kya tum ho jo un darakhton ko ugate ho jin se tum use jalaate ho, ya main hoon jo use ugata hai, tum par meharbani karte hue?
73: Main hi hoon jis ne yeh aag tumhare liye banayi tumhein aakhirat ki aag ki yaad-dihani ke tor par, aur main ne use tum mein se musafiron ke liye faide ka zariya banaya.
74: Aey Rasool! Pas apne bade Rubb ki tasbeeh karein, us har cheez se jo us ke laayaq nahin.
75: Allah sitaron ki jagahon aur un ke madaron ki qasam khata hai.
76: Aur beshak in madaron ki qasam khana ek badi baat hai, agar tum us ki azmat samajh sako, kyunke us mein be-shumaar nishaniyan aur sabaq hain.
77: Aey logo! Beshak woh Quran jo tumhein parh kar sunaya jaata hai ek izzat wala Quran hai, un bade faidon ki wajah se jo us mein hain.
78: Woh ek aise daftar mein hai jo logon ki aankhon se mehfooz hai, yani Lauh-e-Mehfooz.
79: Use sirf woh farishte chhu sakte hain jo gunah aur aibon se paak hain.
80: Woh tamam makhlooq ke Rubb ki taraf se us ke Nabi Muhammad ﷺ par nazil ki hui wahi hai.
81: Aey mushriko! Kya tum phir is baat ko jhutlate ho, aur us par iman nahin laate?
82: Aur kya tum Allah ki un niyamaton par us ka shukr is tarah ada karte ho jo us ne tumhein din, ke tum us ka inkar karte ho aur baarish ko sitaron ke doobne ki taraf mansoob karte ho, yeh keh kar: 'Hum par baarish fulaan sitare ke doobne ki wajah se hui'?
83: Kyun nahin, jab rooh gale tak pahunch jaati hai,
84: aur us waqt tum marne wale ko apne saamne dekhte ho,
85: jab ke mere farishte marne wale ke tum se zyada qareeb hain, lekin tum unhein dekhte nahin.
86: To phir kyun, agar tum dobara nahin uthaye jaane wale, jaisa tum daawa karte ho, badle ke liye,
87: tum us rooh ko wapas nahin laate jo tumhare murde se nikal rahi hai, agar tum sachche ho? Tum yeh nahin kar sakte.
88: Pas agar marne wala un logon mein se ho jo bhalai ki taraf jaldi karte hain,
89: to woh aise aaram mein hoga jis ke baad koi thakan na hogi, achche rizq aur rehmat mein. Us ke liye ek aisi Jannat hogi jis mein woh aish se rahega, us har cheez se faida uthate hue jis ki us ka nafs khwahish kare.
90: Aur agar marne wala Daayin Haath walon mein se ho, to un ke haal ki fikr na karein, kyunke woh salamati aur amaan mein honge.
91: Aur agar marne wala Daayin Haath walon mein se ho, to un ke haal ki fikr na karein, kyunke woh salamati aur amaan mein honge.
92: Aur agar marne wala us ke jhutlane walon mein se ho jo Rasool ﷺ laaye: seedhe raaste se bhatke hue,
93: to us ke liye ek mehmaan-nawazi pesh ki jaayegi, jo nihayat garam paani hoga.
94: Aur use Jahannam ki aag mein jalna hoga.
95: Aey Rasool! Beshak woh qisse jo main ne aap ko sunaye yaqeenan sachche hain, jin mein koi shubah nahin.
96: Pas apne Rubb ke bade naam ki tasbeeh karein, aur use tamam aibon se paak maanein.
